Job_Description":" About tsworks


tsworks is a leading technology innovator, providingtransformative products and services designed for the digital-first world. Ourmission is to provide domain expertise, innovative solutions and thoughtleadership to drive exceptional user and customer experiences. Demonstratingthis commitment, we have a proven track record of championing digitaltransformation for industries such as Banking, Travel and Hospitality, andRetail (including e-commerce and omnichannel), as well as Distribution andSupply Chain, delivering impactful solutions that drive efficiency and growth.We take pride in fostering a workplace where your skills, ideas, and attitudeshape meaningful customer engagements.




About this Role

\u200b

We are seeking a dynamic AI Engineer to join ourAI Research and Development team. Our AI Research team focuses on solvingunique challenges while pushing the boundaries of AI research and innovation,turning these advancements into real-world impact for our customers.

The idealcandidate will have a strong foundation in data analysis, algorithmdevelopment, and machine learning infrastructure, building and training Largeand Small Language Models with experience in both the product development and services industry. This role demands a deep understanding of Generative AI models, industrystandard algorithms, software engineering and cloud technologies, with a strongfocus on validation and optimization processes.



Requirements
In this role, you will be expected toperform:

AlgorithmDevelopment: Develop, optimize, and validate state-of-the-artalgorithms, including Generative AI.

Generative AI Model development and training: Working with, evaluating and using the best Language model for each task, training and building custom LLMs as necessary, and performing necessary prompt engineering to build reliable outcomes.

Model Validation: Create robust internal and external validation frameworks for AI/ML models, ensuring accuracy, reliability, and scalability

Building AI Agents: Building and productionizing AI agents that cater to specific needs in the industry.

Cloud Deployment: Design and deploy ML solutions on cloud platforms such as AWS , Azure , or GCP , ensuring efficiency and scalability.

Data Insights: Analyze large-scale data sets to derive actionable insights and guide AI/ML solution design.

Product Development: Collaborate with cross-functional teams to design and integrate AI/ML components into innovative products and services.

Stay updated with the latest advancements in AI/ML and contribute to the broader research community.

Minimum Qualifications:

Bachelor\u2019s degree or equivalent practical experience in Computer Science, Data Science, or a related technical field.

4+ years of experience in software development, working with data structures and algorithms in one or more programming languages (e.g., Python, Java, R). The candidate should have experience in Microservices or Application development and hands-on knowledge on Dev-Sec-Ops principles and practices.

1+ years of experience with state-of-the-art Generative AI models (e.g., LLMs, Multi-Modal, Large Vision Models) or related concepts (e.g., language modeling, computer vision).

2+ years of experience with ML infrastructure , including model deployment, evaluation, optimization, data processing, and debugging.

\u200b Master\u2019s degree or PhD in Computer Science or a related technical field.

Experience developing accessible technologies to ensure inclusivity in AI solutions.

Knowledge of distributed systems, large-scale system design, or natural language processing.

What We Offer:

The opportunity to work on cutting-edge AI/ML projects that address real-world challenges.

A collaborative environment where innovation and leadership are encouraged.

Access to industry-leading tools and platforms, enabling you to push the boundaries of AI.

About the Team:

Thetsworks AI Research Team focuses on advancing AI technology and applying it across industries. We work ondiverse challenges, ranging from information retrieval to AI-driven healthcaresolutions, aiming to deliver tangible customer benefits. Join us to be at theforefront of AI innovation, delivering meaningful impact to businesses andsociety.



Location: This positionis based in our Bangalore office with a hybrid work model requiring 3 days perweek in the office. You will be working on research and client projects,collaborating with teams and stakeholders as needed.
